metaTitle: Saudi Payroll, WPS and GOSI Compliance Services
metaDescription: Saudi Arabia payroll outsourcing: WPS salary files, GOSI contributions and reconciliations, end-of-service benefits, payslips and labour compliance records.
heroIntro: Compliant payroll for Saudi employers: WPS files, GOSI contributions and end-of-service benefits calculated and documented every month.
overview: Saudi payroll combines WPS submission, GOSI contributions and end-of-service benefits. We run the monthly cycle, prepare the files for submission through your payroll platform and reconcile GOSI each month so records stay clean for labour compliance reviews.
whatWeDo: Run monthly payroll with allowances, deductions and overtime.
Generate WPS files for submission through the payroll platform.
Calculate GOSI contributions and prepare monthly reconciliations.
Handle joiners, exits and final settlements.
Prepare payslips, registers and labour compliance records.

byPlan.cfo: Up to 50 employees. More are priced per head.

note: Payroll is reported in SAR, with INR views available if you also operate in India.

faqs.a: The General Organization for Social Insurance. Employers calculate and pay monthly contributions for employees. We calculate them and prepare monthly reconciliations.
We generate the WPS files for submission through the payroll platform, which you or your authorised representative submit.
